value.rationale: Exact shortest-swap diameter and complete growth polynomial of the canonical Petersen topology give a natural hard benchmark involving all 3,628,800 labeled placements. The seven cycle types of maximally difficult configurations and precisely quantified worst deficiency four of the transport lower bound are informative beyond generic sorting existence bounds; they are not a parameter substitution or arbitrary small slice. No infinite/general theorem is asserted.
